issues.description: The GET endpoint for listing persons is mapped to different path strings across artifacts: the template PersonResource defines the GET mapping as "persons" (GET /persons), while the solution PersonResource defines it as "people" (GET /people). The problem statement and the tests refer to endpoints under "/persons" (e.g., PUT /persons/{personId}/parents). This mismatch of the same conceptual endpoint name (list all Person resources) creates mapping confusion for students: they will expect to use /persons based on the problem description and tests but the solution implementation uses /people, or vice versa.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the endpoint path consistent across all artifacts. The least intrusive fix is to change the solution PersonResource @GetMapping from "people" to "persons" so it matches the template, the problem statement, and the tests (i.e., use @GetMapping("persons")). Alternatively, update the problem statement and tests to use "/people" everywhere, but prefer aligning the solution to the existing templates/tests to avoid extra student confusion.
